name: Mizzah
overview: Mizzah is identified in Scripture as one of the sons of Reuel, who was Esau's son, establishing Mizzah's place within the Edomite lineage. The passages in Genesis 36 and 1 Chronicles 1 consistently list Mizzah alongside his brothers Nahath, Zerah, and Shammah, emphasizing their role as chiefs or dukes in the land of Edom. These references highlight the genealogical and tribal structure descending from Esau through Reuel, situating Mizzah within God's providential plan for the nations.
